questions.stem: A cyclist travels 600 m in 30 seconds. What is their average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance / time = 600 m / 30 s = 20 m/s.

questions.stem: What is the SI unit for both speed and velocity?
questions.explanation: The SI unit for both speed and velocity is metres per second (m/s). While km/h is commonly used in everyday life, m/s is the standard SI unit used in physics.
